screens.t: A share is a small piece of a company. Own one share and you own a tiny slice of its shop, its profit and its future.
The company is split into many equal shares. The price of one share times the number of shares is what the whole company is worth on the market.

options: A tiny slice of the whole company
questions.why: A share is part-ownership, not a loan or a single asset.

questions.q: Market cap: which way is better?
questions.why: Not good or bad: it tells the size – large caps are steadier, small caps can grow faster and fall harder.

lessons.title: Market cap: how big is the company?

screens.t: Big companies are usually steadier; small ones can grow faster but swing more. Size alone says nothing about quality.

lessons.title: P/E: what you pay for ₹1 of profit

screens.t: A low P/E can mean a bargain – or a business in trouble. A high P/E means the market expects growth. Always ask why.

screens.t: A dividend is cash a company pays its shareholders from profit, a fixed ₹ per share.
On the ex-date the share price usually drops by about the dividend, so your total wealth doesn't jump that day.
Comparing returns fairly means adding dividends back – that is what a total return index (TRI) does.

roce.meaning: Business mein lage poore paise (apna + udhaar) par saal ka operating munafa kitna bana. Jaise dukaan mein lagaye har ₹100 se saal mein kitna kamaya.
roce.why: Zyada ROCE matlab paisa achhe se kaam kar raha hai; safe bond se kam ho to business kamzor hai.

roce_avg.meaning: Kai saalon ka ROCE ka average – ek achha ya bura saal pura chitra na badle.
roce_avg.why: Har saal lagatar achha ROCE ek mazboot business ki nishani hai.
roce_avg.example: ROCE 18%, 20% aur 22% teen saal mein → average ROCE (18 + 20 + 22) ÷ 3 = 20%.

roe.meaning: Maalikon ke apne paise (net worth) par saal ka munafa kitna bana.
roe.why: Zyada ROE achha hai, par udhaar se bhi ROE bada dikh sakta hai – saath mein debt zaroor dekho.
roe.example: Munafa ₹150 crore ÷ average net worth ₹1,000 crore = ROE 15%.

roa.meaning: Company ke saare assets par munafa – bank aur lenders ke liye khaas number.
roa.why: Bank ke liye 1% se upar ROA achha maana jaata hai.
roa.example: Munafa ₹120 crore ÷ assets ₹10,000 crore = ROA 1.2% (achha bank).

op_margin.meaning: Har ₹100 ki bikri mein se kharche nikalne ke baad kitna operating munafa bacha.
op_margin.why: Zyada margin matlab business ke paas pricing power ya kam kharche hain.

ebitda.meaning: Interest, tax, depreciation aur amortisation se pehle ka munafa – dhande ki kamai ka kaccha number.
ebitda.why: Alag-alag companies ki kamai ko compare karne mein madad karta hai, par cash aur debt alag se dekho.
ebitda.example: EBIT ₹200 crore + depreciation ₹50 crore = EBITDA ₹250 crore.

pe.meaning: Har ₹1 ke saalana munafe ke liye aap share mein kitne rupaye de rahe ho.
pe.why: Kam P/E sasta ho sakta hai – ya business mein dikkat; zyada P/E matlab market tez growth maan raha hai.

pb.meaning: Share ki keemat company ki book value (net worth) ke kitne guna hai.
pb.why: Banks ke liye kaafi kaam ka; brand wali companies ke liye kam.
pb.example: Market cap ₹3,000 crore ÷ net worth ₹1,500 crore = P/B 2.

ev_ebitda.meaning: Poori company (share + debt − cash) ki keemat uski EBITDA ke kitne guna hai.
ev_ebitda.why: Debt wali aur bina debt wali companies ko barabar tarike se compare karta hai.

earnings_yield.meaning: P/E ka ulta: share ki keemat par saal ka munafa kitne percent.
earnings_yield.why: Isse bond ke yield se compare kar sakte ho – kam ho to share mehenga.

peg.meaning: P/E ko growth se bhaag do – growth ke hisaab se share mehenga hai ya sasta.
peg.why: 1 ke aas-paas PEG ko growth ke liye theek daam maana jaata hai.

eps.meaning: Ek share ke hisse mein saal ka kitna munafa aaya.
eps.why: Saal dar saal badhta EPS hi lambe samay mein share ka daam badhata hai.

mcap.meaning: Poori company ki market mein keemat: ek share ka daam × kul shares.
mcap.why: Badi company aam taur par stable, chhoti company tez badh sakti hai par zyada hilti hai.

fair.meaning: Kai tariko se nikala gaya andaaza ki share asal mein kitne ka hona chahiye.
fair.why: Daam fair value se kaafi neeche ho to galti hone par bhi gaddi (cushion) rehti hai.
fair.example: Methods kehte hain ₹420, ₹480 aur ₹540 → fair value lagbhag ₹480; ₹400 ke daam par share usse neeche hai.

mos.meaning: Daam fair value se kitne percent neeche hai – galti ke liye gaddi.
mos.why: Jitna bada margin, utna galat andaaze se bachaav.

dcf.meaning: Aane wale saalon ke cash ko aaj ke paise mein badal kar jodna.
dcf.why: Growth ya discount rate thoda badla to value bahut badal jaati hai – range samjho, ek number nahi.
dcf.example: Har saal ₹100 crore cash hamesha ke liye, 10% par discount → aaj lagbhag ₹100 crore ÷ 0.1 = ₹1,000 crore.

graham.meaning: Benjamin Graham ka simple formula: EPS aur book value se ek sasta-mehenga ka andaaza.
graham.why: Purane, stable businesses ke liye kaam ka; tez badhti companies ke liye nahi.
graham.example: EPS ₹20 aur book value ₹100 per share → √(22.5 × 20 × 100) ≈ ₹212.

peband.meaning: Pichhle saalon mein share kis P/E range mein raha – usse aaj ka daam range.
peband.why: Agar business nahi badla, to purani range ek achha guide hai.
peband.example: P/E 15 se 25 ke beech 5 saal mein, EPS ₹20 → band ₹300 se ₹500.

evebitda.meaning: Sector ke aam EV/EBITDA se company ki value ka andaaza.
evebitda.why: Peers ke hisaab se value nikalta hai – sector hi mehenga ho to yeh bhi mehenga dikhayega.
evebitda.example: Sector EV/EBITDA 10, company ki EBITDA ₹500 crore → debt ghatane se pehle EV ₹5,000 crore.

gsec.meaning: Sarkar ke 10 saal ke bond ka yield – lagbhag bina risk ki kamai.
gsec.why: Share ka earnings yield isse kam ho to aap risk le kar kam kama rahe ho.
gsec.example: G-sec yield 7% → share ka earnings yield 4% safe bond se kam deta hai.

de.meaning: Udhaar company ke apne paise ke kitne guna hai.
de.why: Kam udhaar matlab bura saal aaye to bhi company tikegi.

icr.meaning: Operating munafa interest ka kitne guna hai – byaaj aaram se bhar paa rahi hai ya nahi.
icr.why: 5 guna se upar aaram; 2 se neeche khatre ki ghanti.

pledge.meaning: Promoters ne apne kitne shares girvi (loan ke liye) rakhe hain.
pledge.why: Daam gira to lender shares bech sakta hai – zyada pledge risk hai.
pledge.example: Promoters ke 50 crore shares, 10 crore girvi → 10 ÷ 50 = 20% pledged.

mscore.meaning: Beneish M-score: hisaab-kitaab mein gadbad ki sambhavna dhoondhne wala score.
mscore.why: −1.78 se upar ho to accounts dhyaan se padho – saboot nahi, ishara hai.
mscore.example: M-score −1.2, −1.78 se upar hai → accounts dhyaan se padhne laayak.

zscore.meaning: Altman Z-score: company ke diwaliya hone ke khatre ka score.
zscore.why: 3 se upar safe, 1.8 ke neeche khatra – banks par lagu nahi.
zscore.example: Z-score 3.5, 3 se upar → safe zone; 1.5 hota to distress zone.

accruals.meaning: Munafe ka woh hissa jo abhi cash ban kar nahi aaya.
accruals.why: Bada accruals matlab kaagaz par munafa, jeb mein kam.
accruals.example: Munafa ₹100 crore, operations se cash ₹60 crore → ₹40 crore munafa abhi cash mein nahi.

sales_cagr.meaning: Bikri har saal average kitne percent badhi.
sales_cagr.why: Lagatar badhti bikri business ke badhne ka pehla saboot hai.

eps_cagr.meaning: Ek share ka munafa (EPS) har saal average kitne percent badha.
eps_cagr.why: EPS ki growth hi lambe samay mein share ka daam chalati hai.

cagr.meaning: Uchal-kood wale safar ko ek saalana growth number mein badalna.
cagr.why: Alag-alag samay ki returns ko barabar compare kar sakte ho.

ttm.meaning: Trailing twelve months – pichhle chaar quarters ka jod, taaki latest saal dikhe.
ttm.why: Saal khatam hone ka intezaar kiye bina taaza number milta hai.
ttm.example: November mein TTM bikri = September tak ke chaar quarters.

cfo_pat.meaning: Munafe ka kitna hissa sach mein cash ban kar aaya.
cfo_pat.why: 1 ke aas-paas achha; lagatar kam ho to munafa sirf kaagaz par ho sakta hai.

cfopat.meaning: Operations ka cash ÷ munafa – munafa asli hai ya nahi.
cfopat.why: Kai saal 0.8 se upar ho to munafa bharosemand.

debtor_days.meaning: Customers paisa dene mein kitne din lagate hain.
debtor_days.why: Din badh rahe hon to paisa udhaar mein phansa hai – dukaan ka 'khata' lamba ho raha hai.

inventory_days.meaning: Maal godown mein bikne se pehle kitne din padha rehta hai.
inventory_days.why: Kam din matlab maal jaldi bikta hai; zyada din matlab paisa maal mein atka.
inventory_days.example: Inventory ₹20 crore ÷ maal ki laagat ₹73 crore × 365 = 100 din.

payable_days.meaning: Company apne suppliers ko paisa dene mein kitne din leti hai.
payable_days.why: Theek range mein ho to achha; bahut zyada ho to suppliers pareshaan ho sakte hain.
payable_days.example: Payables ₹15 crore ÷ maal ki laagat ₹73 crore × 365 = 75 din.

promoter.meaning: Company chalane wale parivaar ya group ke paas kitne percent shares hain.
promoter.why: Zyada holding matlab unka apna paisa daav par – par yahi akela kaafi nahi.
promoter.example: Promoters ke paas 60 crore mein se 30 crore shares = 50%.

promoter_chg.meaning: Saal bhar mein promoter holding kitne points badli.
promoter_chg.why: Promoters kharid rahe hon to achha ishara; bech rahe hon to wajah poochho.
promoter_chg.example: Promoter holding saal pehle 52%, ab 50% → badlaav −2 points.

insider.meaning: Andar ke log (directors, promoters) ne kitna kharida minus kitna becha.
insider.why: Andar wale apne paise se kharidein to business par bharosa dikhta hai.
insider.example: Insiders ne ₹12 crore kharida, ₹4 crore becha → net kharid ₹8 crore.

redflags.meaning: Aise ishare jo kehte hain 'ruko, pehle samjho' – jaise pledge, auditor ka jaana.
redflags.why: Ek bhi bada red flag achhe numbers ko bekaar kar sakta hai.
redflags.example: 2 red flags: zyada pledging aur haal hi mein auditor ka istifa.

rsi.meaning: RSI batata hai pichhle 14 din mein daam kitni tezi se upar ya neeche gaya.
rsi.why: 30 se neeche tezi se gira, 70 se upar tezi se chadha – kal ka andaaza nahi.
rsi.example: RSI 25, 30 se neeche → daam tezi se gira; RSI 75, 70 se upar → tezi se chadha.

dma.meaning: Pichhle 50 ya 200 din ke daam ka average – lambi chaal (trend).
dma.why: Daam 200-day average se upar = lamba uptrend; neeche = downtrend.
dma.example: Daam ₹550, 200-day average ₹500 → lambe trend se 10% upar.

high52.meaning: Aaj ka daam pichhle 1 saal ke sabse uche daam se kitna neeche hai.
high52.why: High ke paas matlab momentum; bahut neeche matlab kuch gadbad ya mauka – wajah dekho.
high52.example: High ₹600, daam ₹480 → 1-saal ke high se 20% neeche.

volratio.meaning: Aaj kitne shares bike, aam din ke muqable kitne guna.
volratio.why: Achanak bahut zyada volume matlab koi khabar – pehle khabar padho.
volratio.example: Aaj 5 lakh shares bike, aam taur par 2 lakh → 2.5× normal.

tv.meaning: Ek din mein share mein kitne rupaye ka len-den hua.
tv.why: Zyada traded value matlab kharidna-bechna aasaan.

vix.meaning: India VIX: agle 30 din mein market kitna hilega, uska andaaza – darr ka meter.
vix.why: Kam VIX shaant market, zyada VIX ghabrahat.

breadth.meaning: Kitne shares upar gaye aur kitne neeche – market ki chaurai.
breadth.why: Bahut saare shares upar hon to tezi har jagah hai, sirf kuch bade naam nahi.
breadth.example: 1,800 upar aur 900 neeche = har taraf kharidaari.

fii.meaning: Videshi (FII) aur desi institutions (DII) ne kitna kharida minus kitna becha.
fii.why: Bade paise ka rukh dikhata hai; ek din se kuch tay nahi hota.
fii.example: FIIs −₹2,000 crore = unhone kharid se ₹2,000 crore zyada becha.

shocker.meaning: Result ummeed se kitna alag aaya.
shocker.why: Bada jhatka daam ko hila deta hai – wajah ek baar ki hai ya lambi, yeh dekho.
shocker.example: Munafa lagbhag ₹100 crore ki ummeed, aaya ₹60 crore → 40% kam.

tri.meaning: Total return index: index ki chaal plus dividends – poora return.
tri.why: Funds aur portfolios ko isi se compare karna sahi hai.
tri.example: Index 10% upar plus dividends 1.5% → TRI lagbhag 11.5% upar.

xirr.meaning: Alag-alag dino par lagaye paise ka saalana return.
xirr.why: SIP ya kai kharid ka sahi return yahi batata hai.
xirr.example: ₹1 lakh January mein aur ₹1 lakh July mein, December mein ₹2.2 lakh → XIRR lagbhag 26% saalana.

avgprice.meaning: Aapke saare shares ka average kharid daam (charges ke saath).
avgprice.why: Isi se aapka munafa ya nuksaan nikalta hai.

pnl.meaning: Realised = bech kar mila munafa; unrealised = abhi kaagaz par.
pnl.why: Unrealised munafa daam ke saath badalta rehta hai.
pnl.example: ₹100 par kharida, ab ₹130: unrealised ₹30 per share; 10 shares becho → realised ₹300.

ltcg.meaning: 12 mahine se zyada rakhe shares bechne par munafa – long-term capital gain.
ltcg.why: Long-term munafe par tax kam hai aur ek limit tak tax-free.
ltcg.example: 1 Jan 2025 ko kharida, 2 Feb 2026 ko becha = long-term.

stcg.meaning: 12 mahine se kam rakhe shares bechne par munafa – short-term capital gain.
stcg.why: Short-term munafe par tax zyada lagta hai.
stcg.example: 1 Mar 2026 ko kharida, 1 Oct 2026 ko becha = short-term (12 mahine se kam).

drawdown.meaning: Sabse uche point se ab kitne percent neeche.
drawdown.why: Girawat sehne ki taiyaari pehle se ho to ghabrahat mein galat faisla nahi hota.
drawdown.example: Peak ₹10 lakh, ab ₹8 lakh → (10 − 8) ÷ 10 = peak se 20% neeche.

core.meaning: App ka Core score: quality, value aur momentum mila kar 0–100.
core.why: Zyada score ka matlab teeno taraf se achha – phir bhi apna research zaroori.
core.example: Quality 80, value 60, momentum 70 → Core score lagbhag 70 (100 mein).

qvsector.meaning: Apne sector ke companies ke muqable quality kahan khadi hai.
qvsector.why: Sector ke hisaab se compare karna sahi hai – bank aur IT alag hote hain.
qvsector.example: ROCE 10 mein se 8 peers se behtar → sector mein lagbhag 80th percentile.

bizhealth.meaning: Business ki sehat chhe hisson mein: munafa, growth, balance sheet, cash, value, momentum.
bizhealth.why: Kamzor hissa jaldi dikh jaata hai.
bizhealth.example: Profitability 90, growth 40, balance sheet 80 → mazboot par dheemi growth.

piotroski.meaning: 9 haan/na tests: kya business pichhle saal se zyada sehatmand hua.
piotroski.why: 7 ya zyada achha, 3 ya kam kamzor.

best_method.meaning: Har tarah ke business ko us method se aanka jaata hai jo usse suit kare – bank ko net worth par kamai se, cyclical ko normal saal se. Baaki methods doosri raay hain.
best_method.why: Ek sahi method kai galat methods ke average se behtar hai.
best_method.example: Ek bank: justified price-to-book ₹800 → daam ₹600 us value se 25% sasta.

rules_v12.meaning: Verdict rules ka side-by-side test: Rules v1.0 jaisa hi, par value best method ki, aur methods ke na milne par Buy ke liye zyada margin. Official verdict Rules v1.0 hi hai.
rules_v12.why: Zyada uncertainty ke liye zyada margin of safety chahiye – rules, prediction nahi.
rules_v12.example: Main value ₹1,000, agreement Medium → Buy ke liye daam ₹700 ya kam (30% neeche).

verdict.meaning: App ke rules ka faisla: Buy, Accumulate, Hold, Trim ya Avoid – seekhne ke liye, salah nahi.
verdict.why: Rules ek jaise lagte hain, emotion nahi.
verdict.example: Quality 75 aur daam fair value se 30% neeche, koi red flag nahi → screener ke rules par 🟢 Buy.

roe_avg.meaning: Kai saalon ka ROE ka average.
roe_avg.why: Lagatar achha ROE ek saal ke ROE se zyada bharosemand.

value_pillar.meaning: Core score ka value hissa: P/E, P/B aur earnings yield par kitna sasta.
value_pillar.why: Sasta hona tabhi kaam ka jab business bhi achha ho.
value_pillar.example: 100 mein se 70 stocks se P/E, P/B aur earnings yield par sasta → value lagbhag 70.

momentum_pillar.meaning: Core score ka momentum hissa: pichhle 12 mahine ka return doosron ke muqable.
momentum_pillar.why: Momentum batata hai market abhi kya pasand kar raha hai – hamesha nahi chalta.
momentum_pillar.example: 12-mahine ka return 100 mein se 80 stocks se behtar → momentum lagbhag 80.

lens.meaning: Kisi mashhoor investor ke style ke usoolon ki checklist – unki apni raay nahi.
lens.why: Alag-alag nazariye se ek hi company dekhne mein madad.
lens.example: Buffett ke 8 mein se 6 checks paas → 6 ÷ 8 = 75%.

invested.meaning: Aapne kitna lagaya aur aaj uski keemat kitni hai.
invested.why: Dono ka fark hi aapka munafa ya nuksaan hai.

tv_daily.meaning: Roz ka average len-den rupaye mein.
tv_daily.why: Kam len-den wale share mein bechna mushkil ho sakta hai.
tv_daily.example: Roz average ₹12 crore ka len-den → chhoti raqam kharidna-bechna aasaan.

fcf_yield.meaning: Free cash flow market cap ka kitne percent – share ki keemat par asli cash kamai.
fcf_yield.why: Zyada yield matlab cash ke hisaab se sasta.
fcf_yield.example: Free cash flow ₹50 crore ÷ market cap ₹1,000 crore = 5%.

market_mood.meaning: Market ka mood 0–100: breadth, 200-day average se upar shares, VIX aur Nifty ka trend mila kar.
market_mood.why: Yeh aaj ka haal batata hai, kal ka andaaza nahi.
market_mood.example: Breadth 74, 200-day se upar 15, VIX 60, trend 37 → mood (74 + 15 + 60 + 37) ÷ 4 = 47 – Neutral.

market_timing.meaning: Sahi waqt par nikalna aur wapas aana – do baar sahi hona padta hai.
market_timing.why: Apni tay raqam aur rules par tike rehna aam taur par behtar rehta hai.
market_timing.example: 20 saal mein market ke 10 sabse achhe dino par bahar rahe → zyada tar munafa haath se gaya.

concentration.meaning: Ek share ya ek sector mein aapka kitna paisa hai.
concentration.why: Apni limit rakho taaki ek company aapka poora nateeja tay na kare.
concentration.example: Ek share ₹30,000 ka, kul ₹2 lakh → 30,000 ÷ 2,00,000 = 15%, 10% ki limit se upar.

exit_check.meaning: Paper portfolio ke frozen exit rules aapki holding par – kab dobara dekhna hai.
exit_check.why: Laal ka matlab dobara socho, turant becho nahi.
exit_check.example: Rank keep zone se bahar → 🟠 agle rebalance par dekho.

investment_thesis.meaning: Share save karte waqt likhi wajah – kyun achha laga tha.
investment_thesis.why: Daam badla ho to note padho: wajah abhi bhi sach hai?
investment_thesis.example: Note: 'debt-free, 15% saalana badh rahi'. Saal baad debt badh raha hai → wajah badal gayi.

sales.meaning: Saal mein customers ko kitne ka maal ya service becha – kharche se pehle.
sales.why: Munafa aur cash sab yahin se shuru hote hain.

price.meaning: Aaj NSE band hone par ek share ka aakhri bhaav.
price.why: P/E, P/B, margin of safety – sab is bhaav ke saath badalte hain.

change.meaning: Kal ke band bhaav se aaj bhaav kitna badla. Hara = upar, laal = neeche – bas itna hi matlab.
change.why: Ek din ki chaal zyaadatar shor hai; khabar ya bhaari volume ke saath ho tab dhyaan do.

period_return.meaning: Diye gaye samay (1 hafta, 1 mahina, 1 saal) mein bhaav kitna badla.
period_return.why: Stock kahan se aaya hai, yeh batata hai – kahan jaayega, yeh nahi.

chart.meaning: Samay ke saath bhaav ki tasveer, har trading din ka ek point.
chart.why: Trend aur badi giraavat ek nazar mein dikh jaati hai.
chart.example: A line from ₹500 to ₹750 over a year = up 50%.

signal.meaning: Number ke paas chhoti rangeen batti: hara = sector ke hisaab se achha, peela = beech mein, laal = kamzor.
signal.why: Har number padhe bina strong aur weak jagah dikh jaati hai.
signal.example: ROCE 22% where the sector's good line is 15% → green.

badge.meaning: Stock ya card par chhota label – verdict, group, flag ya status.
badge.why: Zaroori label list mein hi dikh jaate hain.
badge.example: 🟢 Buy badge = the verdict rules put the stock in the Buy group tonight.

data_date.meaning: Yeh number kab ka hai: bhaav ki tareekh, filing ki tareekh ya check chalne ki tareekh.
data_date.why: Purana number gumraah kar sakta hai; tareekh se taazgi pata chalti hai.
data_date.example: Results filed 9 Oct 2026 → the profit numbers are for the quarter to 30 Sep 2026.

count.meaning: Is group ya list mein kitne stocks / items / din hain.
count.why: 3 stocks aur 300 stocks ki list mein bahut fark hai.

statement_line.meaning: Company ke saalana hisaab ki ek line – sales, munafa, karz, cash – NSE filing se, ₹ crore mein.
statement_line.why: Site ke saare ratio inhi kachche numbers se bante hain.
statement_line.example: Sales ₹2,67,021 crore in FY2026 vs ₹2,55,324 crore in FY2025 → up 4.6%.

segment_share.meaning: Company ki sales ka kitna hissa kis business se aata hai, company ki apni segment report se.
segment_share.why: Company ko asal mein kya chalata hai, aur ek policy se kitna asar padega.

check_light.meaning: Raat ke ek job ya data check ka haal: ✅ ho gaya, 🟡 der / adhoora, 🔴 fail, grey = apni marzi se band.
check_light.why: Aaj ke number poore hain ya nahi, bharosa karne se pehle pata chalta hai.
check_light.example: Prices ✅ 2 min of a 5 min budget; Back-fill 🟡 stopped at its time limit.

actions_minutes.meaning: Is mahine nightly jobs ne GitHub Actions ke kitne minute use kiye, free allowance ke muqable.
actions_minutes.why: Allowance khatam to nightly agle mahine tak ruk jaata hai.
actions_minutes.example: 1,200 minutes in 15 days → about 2,400 for the month.

quantity.meaning: Aapke kitne shares hain, aapki likhi kharid-bikri se. Sirf is browser mein rakha.
quantity.why: Har value aur P&L = shares × bhaav.

weight.meaning: Aapke portfolio ki value ka kitna hissa is stock (ya sector) mein hai.
weight.why: Bahut bada weight = ek stock poore portfolio ko hila sakta hai.

watch_gap.meaning: Watchlist mein daalne ke din se bhaav kitna badla.
watch_gap.why: Idea haath se nikal gaya ya buy zone mein aaya, yeh dikhta hai.

investor_stake.meaning: Bade investor ke paas company ka kitna hissa hai, quarterly shareholding filing se (1% ya zyaada hi naam se dikhte hain).
investor_stake.why: Mashhoor investor kya rakhte hain – ek quarter tak ki deri ke saath.

index_level.meaning: Index (Nifty 50, Nifty 500, sector index) ki aaj ki band value.
index_level.why: Poore market ya sector ka haal ek nazar mein.

world_index.meaning: Videsh ka bada market (US, Europe, Asia) – aakhri band value aur chaal, sirf jaankari ke liye.
world_index.why: Indian market aksar US ke raat ke rukh mein khulta hai.

fx.meaning: Ek videshi currency ke badle kitne rupaye (jaise ₹ per dollar).
fx.why: Kamzor rupaya exporters ko madad, importers ko nuksaan.

figure.meaning: Is card par ek number ya label. Card ka title batata hai yeh kis baare mein hai.
figure.why: Har number ka source likha hai, aap khud check kar sakte hain.
figure.example: '38 stocks' on a screen card = 38 stocks pass its rule tonight.

policy_item.meaning: Sarkar ka ek kadam – bhashan, ghoshna, Cabinet faisla, Budget allocation, notification – jo kuch sectors ko madad ya nuksaan de sakta hai, sirf official source se.
policy_item.why: Sarkari policy saalon tak poore sector ko upar ya neeche kar sakti hai.
policy_item.example: 'Raise processed-food exports' – announced in a speech, then ₹2,000 crore allocated in the Budget → stage moves up.

policy_stage.meaning: Policy kahan tak pahunchi: 🗣 bhashan → 📄 ghoshna → ✅ Cabinet manzoori → 💰 Budget mein paisa → 📜 notification / paisa chalu → 📊 nateeje dikhe.
policy_stage.why: Bhashan bhool sakte hain; paisa aur notified niyam sector badalne ki zyaada sambhavna rakhte hain.
policy_stage.example: A scheme announced in March (📄), Cabinet approved in June (✅), ₹500 crore in the Budget (💰).

policy_effect.meaning: Hamari samajh: policy se sector ko 🟢 madad, ⚪ koi asar nahi, ya 🔴 nuksaan, ek line ki wajah ke saath.
policy_effect.why: Kaun sa sector aage dhakela ja raha hai aur kaun peeche.
policy_effect.example: Customs duty on imported solar cells raised → 🟢 for Indian cell makers, 🔴 for buyers of imported cells.

policy_exposure.meaning: Company ki sales ka kitna hissa us business se hai jis par policy ka asar hai – company ki segment report se.
policy_exposure.why: 60% sales wali company ke liye policy 5% wali se kahin zyaada maayne rakhti hai.
policy_exposure.example: Agri segment ₹180 crore of ₹1,000 crore sales → 180 ÷ 1,000 × 100 = 18% exposed.

policy_lookcloser.meaning: Flag jab hamara verdict ek taraf aur pichhle 6 mahine ki 2+ paisa-stage (💰 / 📜) sector policies doosri taraf.
policy_lookcloser.why: Stock dobara padhne ka ishaara, trade ka nahi. Score ya verdict mein nahi.
policy_lookcloser.example: Verdict 🟢 Buy, but 2 notified duty changes hurt its sector → Look closer.

budget_line.meaning: Union Budget mein ek mantralaya ya scheme ka paisa: is saal ka estimate vs pichhle saal ka.
budget_line.why: Zyaada paisa = supply karne wale sectors ko zyaada orders ho sakte hain.

budget_duty.meaning: Budget ke din customs, excise ya GST mein badlaav.
budget_duty.why: Input par duty kam = use karne walon ko madad; import par duty zyaada = desi banane walon ko madad.
budget_duty.example: Customs duty on gold 15% → 6%: cheaper imports for jewellers.

quick_price.meaning: Aaj ke trading ka bhaav, sirf dekhne ke liye – neeche kheenchne ya ↻ dabane par aata hai, save nahi hota. Yahoo se, kuch minute der se ho sakta hai.
quick_price.why: Score, verdict aur alerts kal raat ke NSE band bhaav par hi rehte hain.

redflags.reason: Profit ₹120 crore but only ₹15 crore arrived as cash – profit that doesn't turn into cash is a warning.
Customers take 190 days to pay – much of the sales is money still owed, not money received.
Promoters have pledged 65% of their shares – a price fall can force sales and a change of control.
An auditor leaving mid-year, without a clear reason, is one of the strongest warning signs.
Interest of ₹25 crore against EBIT of ₹30 crore = cover of only 1.2× – one bad year and it can't pay.
40% of sales go to firms the promoters own – related-party deals can move profit around.
Stock sits in the warehouse for 260 days – unsold goods tie up cash and can go out of fashion.
The number of shares doubled – each old share now owns half as much of the profit (dilution).
Loans are 2.8 times the owners' money – heavy debt leaves no room for a bad year.
Profit up 35% while sales fell 8% – find the one-off gain or accounting change before trusting it.
Promoters sold 16 points of their stake in one year – ask why the people who know the business best are leaving.
₹45 crore of ₹50 crore profit is 'other income' – the core business barely earns anything.
Three years of negative cash from operations while sales grow – growth is being paid for with borrowed money.
Possible claims three times the owners' money sit off the balance sheet – one lost case could wipe it out.
Changing the accounting year again and again makes results hard to compare – a classic way to hide a bad stretch.

cases.intro: A plastics maker with a rising share price.
clues: Sales up 25% a year for 3 years.
Cash from operations negative every year.
cases.explain: Profit isn't arriving as cash, customers pay slowly and promoters have borrowed against their shares – three warnings together.

cases.intro: A paint company with no news for months.
clues: Cash from operations about equal to profit.
cases.explain: High, steady returns, almost no debt and profit backed by cash – nothing here needs explaining away.

cases.intro: A steel maker that just reported record profit.
cases.explain: A low P/E at peak profits in a cyclical business is often a trap, and the debt leaves little room when prices fall.

cases.intro: A snacks brand with a high P/E.
clues: Sales growing 18% a year for 6 years.
cases.explain: Expensive, yes – but the business itself shows no warning signs. A high price is a valuation question, not a red flag.

cases.intro: A builder with a big order book.
cases.explain: An auditor exit, large possible claims, promoters selling and thin interest cover – every clue points the same way.

cases.intro: A textile exporter after a bad year.
clues: Profit fell 30% last year on weak demand.
cases.explain: A bad year is not a red flag by itself: low debt, positive cash and promoters buying suggest a business riding out a cycle.

cases.intro: A small lender growing loans fast.
clues: Raised new shares 3 times in 2 years.
cases.explain: Very fast loan growth with rising bad loans, a weak ROA and repeated share issues is how lending problems usually start.

cases.intro: A pump maker that few people follow.
clues: Price 30% below the app's fair value.
cases.explain: Improving health, steady growth, easy interest cover and a margin of safety – a case with no flags.

read: Low: you pay little for each ₹1 of profit – check why it is cheap.
High: the market expects fast growth – disappointments hurt.
Weak: the business earns less on its capital than a safe bond.
Strong: each ₹100 of capital earns ₹15 or more a year.
Low debt – the business mostly runs on its own money.
Some debt – fine if profits are steady.
Heavy debt – a bad year can hurt a lot.
Above fair value – no cushion if the estimate is wrong.
A big cushion: the price is well below the estimate.
Compounding: each year's gain earns its own gain the next year.
